cd /work && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
im=Image.open('observations/obs_0036.png').convert('RGB'); px=im.load()
def isbrown(c):
    r,g,b=c
    return r>70 and r<200 and r-g>25 and r-b>45
# topmost brown per column in lower half
for u in range(100,440,10):
    top=None
    for v in range(300,512):
        if isbrown(px[u,v]): top=v; break
    print(u,top, px[u,top] if top else None, px[u,505])
"
